title: CIA Symbolic Account / Karma Ledger Contract
scope: Potatoverse project-internal symbolic accounting attached to character dossiers
boundary: This is not money, credit scoring, legal debt, guilt, diagnosis, or an objective measurement of human worth. Entries must be explicitly sourced as project language, authored interpretation, or a recorded repair/credit claim.

account_fields.status: Symbolic account state. Defaults to unassessed.
account_fields.good_karma: Optional sourced/project-authored credits. Never inferred from popularity, loyalty or inactivity.
account_fields.karmic_debt: Optional sourced/project-authored debits. Never treated as legal/financial debt.
account_fields.dooley_welfare: Optional playful project allowance. If enabled, a display-only accrual may be calculated from an explicit start date and rate.
account_fields.interest: Optional project-defined symbolic interest on a specific sourced entry; never silently compounded.
account_fields.outstanding: Open repair conditions, promises, unresolved project obligations or recovery questions.
account_fields.entries: Dated ledger rows with type, amount_or_scale, source_mode, source_ref, note and status.

welfare_rule.note: A live counter is permitted only when the dossier explicitly enables it. The counter is theatrical project UI, not a financial asset.

activity_visualization.rule: Visual prominence reflects archive recency/status only, never moral value.
activity_visualization.interaction: Hover/focus restores full opacity for readability.

media.portrait: Optional dossier-owned image path/URL with caption and source.
media.evidence_images: Optional screenshots, memes, posts or project images with source metadata.
media.rule: Do not attach an image to a real person unless the archive explicitly identifies the source and subject.
